description: Layer concept rounds 1 and 2 (docs/design/layer-concepts.md, layer-concepts-2.md; basalt3 is layer 3's columns, bluer again): the rock of layer 1 (rust-brown packed regolith going to dark shale) and of layer 2 (grey-green shale), the basalt of option C's columns (a cool grey-black, bluer in layer 2: the amber lamp tint warms everything toward brown, so a warm basalt reads as wood), basalt for the plugs, weathered Company concrete and its grime, a lighter crust than the default (the breach crust, and the plates of the lava's skin), and lava light for the cracks of the crust. Ramps run dark to light.
